confidence_notes: Food anchors use Punta Cana city-level price averages translated approximately from Dominican pesos to USD. The price index did not list cocktail or wine by the glass, so those are estimated at about 2.5× and 1.6× the observed draft-beer price. Hostel listings show four properties with starting rates, while Expedia's 3-star monthly prices exclude taxes and fees; annual accommodation anchors are therefore less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; the food-price observations and accommodation pages were specific to Punta Cana.
